rows.name: cell_volume
rows.description: Per-cell volume read off cell_df; the enclosed-cell geometry that emerges on the closed shell.

rows.name: cell_area
rows.description: Per-cell area read off cell_df (3.90-15.65); the per-cell shape readout on the curved shell.

rows.name: lumen_volume
rows.description: Enclosed lumen volume read off the engine settings (261.69 at rest = preferred volume); the morphogenesis state variable.

rows.name: lumen_pressure
rows.description: Lumen pressure = elasticity x (volume - preferred volume); 0.0 at rest. The trajectory as the lumen fills/drains is the next dynamic readout.

rows.name: bm_surface
rows.description: Basal BM-coupling surface (78 faces, total area 202.47); the shell the collagen network attaches to.
